about_short_description.short_description: Streak operates as a rewarding digital bank for teenagers.

product.name: Streak Account
product.description: A user profile created on the Streak platform required to apply for a wallet account, enabling access to Streak's digital banking services.

product.name: Streak Wallets
product.description: Prepaid digital wallets issued in various KYC-compliance tiers, enabling users to store funds, make payments, and transfer money within regulatory limits.

product.name: Streak Card
product.description: A physical prepaid card linked to the Streak wallet, used for payments at merchants and ATM withdrawals within wallet limits.

product.name: Family Management Feature
product.description: A platform feature allowing users to create and manage a family group with parents, adults, and teenagers for shared wallet access and oversight.
